A salon in Paphos

NA HairDesign is at Agion Anargiron Avenue 7 in Paphos. Inside, the gold NA logo hangs on a stone-look wall, a green plant wall sits in a black circle and the reception counter is covered in leaves. Clients come for colour, cuts and wedding hair, and several have been coming back for years.
